Master's in marine, estuarine and environmental sciences, University of Maryland.

updates.name: Samuel D. Fuhlendorf
updates.bio: Regents Professor in Natural Resource Ecology and Management at Oklahoma State University, holding the Groendyke Chair in Wildlife Conservation. Researches conservation of grasslands and their wildlife: how disturbance-driven heterogeneity shapes grassland structure and function, fire ecology, landscape-scale rangeland conservation, and how animals use landscapes. Ph.D. and M.S. in rangeland ecology and management, Texas A&M.
updates.research_interests: disturbance-driven heterogeneity in grasslands; fire ecology; grazing; landscape ecology; rangeland and wildlife conservation; woody plant encroachment; lesser and greater prairie-chicken; bobwhite quail; animal use of landscapes

PhD, University of Colorado Boulder.
